set.body:
Outcome: DL2 source cast and row record (slim E1). Per film, a cast with stable identifiers from annotations, speech and frames; each row tagged with participants, action and, for dialogue, speaker. Subsumes roadmap M3 (speaker-labelled evidence).
Admission: every tag cites row text, a speech span or a frame; identity per ADRs 0024/0027. No uncited cast member.
Exit: coverage report for Sherlock and one FilmFestival film (share of rows with an identified participant, share of dialogue with a speaker) plus an owner spot-check of three scenes. Plan: docs/plans/2026-11-16-detail-mapping-plan.md#dl2-source-cast-and-row-record.
set.title: [detail-mapping] DL2 source cast and row record (speakers, participants)
